how_to_apply: Sainik School Bijapur Recruitment 2026 follows an offline application process - there is no online application portal for this notification. Candidates must apply as follows:
Download the application form from the school website, www.sssbj.in (notification–vacancy link).
Fill the prescribed application form completely and attach self-attested copies of all required documents.
Enclose the application fee Demand Draft and a self-addressed envelope with Rs 55/- postage stamps.
Send the completed application by post so that it reaches the Principal, Sainik School Bijapur, Athani Road, District – Vijayapura, Karnataka – 586108, within the last date.

Applications received after the due date, or without the supporting documents, prescribed fee, or in the prescribed format, will be rejected without intimation. The school will not be responsible for postal delay or a missing envelope, and no claim will be entertained on this account.

No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the previous employer, where applicable

content_sections.heading: Sainik School Bijapur Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 17 vacancies are available across the following posts and categories: The notification states that the number of vacancies mentioned above may increase or decrease at the discretion of the Principal, Sainik School Bijapur.

content_sections.heading: Sainik School Bijapur Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Age is reckoned as on 01 October 2026. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying. Qualification requirements are specific to each post. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the complete essential and desirable qualification clauses, as several posts have multiple alternative qualification routes. Desirable qualifications common to most teaching posts include prior TGT/school teaching experience, knowledge of computer applications, and working knowledge of English. These are preferred but not mandatory, as per the notification.

rows.post: TGT (English, Biology, Maths, Kannada, Physics, Social Science), Craft Instructor

rows.essential_qualification_summary: Integrated PG course from an NCTE-recognized institution in Chemistry with at least 50% marks including B.Ed., OR Master's Degree in Chemistry (50% marks) with B.Ed./B.Ed.-M.Ed./four-year integrated degree from an NCTE-recognized institution as specified

Integrated PG course from an NCTE-recognized institution in English with at least 50% marks including B.Ed., OR Master's Degree in English (50% marks) with B.Ed./B.Ed.-M.Ed./four-year integrated degree from an NCTE-recognized institution as specified

Four-year integrated degree or Bachelor's/Honours degree with 50% marks in English combination, with B.Ed./B.Ed.-M.Ed./RCI B.Ed. (Special Education) as specified, or PG in the subject with 55% marks plus B.Ed.-M.Ed.; must have qualified CTET Paper-II; must have studied English as an elective/main subject for at least 3 years/6 semesters

Four-year integrated degree or Bachelor's/Honours degree with 50% marks in the concerned subject combination, with B.Ed./B.Ed.-M.Ed./RCI B.Ed. (Special Education) as specified, or PG with 55% marks plus B.Ed.-M.Ed.; must have qualified CTET Paper-II; must have studied Biology for at least 3 years/6 semesters

Similar four-year integrated/Bachelor's-Honours + B.Ed. route as above; must have studied Mathematics as elective/main subject for at least 3 years/6 semesters, Physics for at least 1 year/2 semesters, and one of Chemistry/Electronics/Computer Science/Statistics for at least 1 year/2 semesters. Candidates with B.Sc. (Hons) in Physics or Chemistry are not eligible for this post
Similar four-year integrated/Bachelor's-Honours + B.Ed. route as above; must have qualified CTET Paper-II; must have studied Kannada as an elective/main subject
Similar four-year integrated/Bachelor's-Honours + B.Ed. route as above; must have qualified CTET Paper-II; must have studied Physics for at least 3 years/6 semesters

Similar four-year integrated/Bachelor's-Honours + B.Ed. route as above; must have qualified CTET Paper-II; must have studied any two of History, Geography, Economics, Political Science during graduation (one must be History or Geography) for at least 3 years/6 semesters as elective/main subject
Senior Secondary/Intermediate with at least 50% aggregate marks, plus a Degree or Diploma in the craft field from a recognized university/institution

Three-year Diploma in General Nursing or B.Sc. Nursing from a recognized institution with valid registration, plus 5 years' experience (or ex-servicemen of Medical Assistant trade with at least 5 years' service after training) and proficiency in Hindi and English

10th Pass from a recognized Board; multi-skill knowledge (Bakery, Plumbing, Carpenter, Horse Care, Housekeeping, Office Equipment Handling) preferred; experience in a Boarding School preferred; knowledge of Kannada, Hindi and English required; physically fit

faq.question: Q1. What is Sainik School Bijapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a regular-basis recruitment drive by Sainik School Bijapur, under Advt No 01/2026, for 17 vacancies across PGT, TGT, Craft Instructor, Nursing Assistant, and General Employees (MTS) posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Sainik School Bijapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 17 vacancies are available across 11 post categories, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Sainik School Bijapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement. The exact calendar date is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Sainik School Bijapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post, ranging from 10th Pass for General Employees (MTS) to specific degree, B.Ed., and CTET requirements for PGT/TGT posts, and nursing/craft-specific qualifications for Nursing Assistant and Craft Instructor. Full post-wise details are given in the Eligibility Criteria section above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Sainik School Bijapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Age limit varies by post: 21–40 years for PGT posts, 21–35 years for TGT posts and Craft Instructor, and 18–50 years for Nursing Assistant and General Employees (MTS), all as on 01 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for Sainik School Bijapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs 500/- (non-refundable) via Demand Draft in favour of "Principal, Sainik School Bijapur," along with a self-addressed envelope carrying Rs 55/- postage stamps.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for Sainik School Bijapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by downloading the form from www.sssbj.in and sending the duly filled form with required documents and fee by post to the Principal, Sainik School Bijapur. There is no online application mode for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Sainik School Bijapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is purely merit-based. Only short-listed candidates are called for a Written Test / Practical Test / Interview, with no TA/DA admissible.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for Sainik School Bijapur Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Basic pay ranges from Rs 18,000/- for General Employees (MTS) to Rs 47,600/- for PGT posts, as per 7th CPC, along with allowances and benefits as per Sainik Schools Society Rules.
